added_models.model: Hypoxia-induced HRD (contextual synthetic lethality): hypoxic human cancer cells with RAD51/BRCA1 down-regulation sensitised to PARP inhibition

engagement.population: Hypoxic human cancer cell lines (HeLa, others) in vitro
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. The trial paper (Cecchini 2023) names this Yale work (its refs 7-8: Bindra 2004, Hegan 2010) as 'our preclinical work'; Chan 2010 (doi 10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-10-2352) independently showed the same PARPi hypersensitivity of hypoxic cells. The abstract names only 'chemical PARP inhibitors', so product_in_model is unknown; olaparib itself was later shown active in hypoxic NSCLC xenografts (Jiang 2016, doi 10.1016/j.ijrobp.2016.01.035). model_kind ex_vivo because the enum has no in-vitro cell-line value.
engagement.quote: Here we show that PARP inhibition to block BER is toxic to hypoxic cancer cells, in which homology-dependent repair (HDR) is known to be down-regulated.
engagement.note: Model readout was RAD51/BRCA1 loss under hypoxia; NCI10066 measured no tumour hypoxia or HR marker in patients after ramucirumab.
engagement.short: Hypoxia-HRD readout never measured in patients
engagement.reason: No hypoxia or HR PD in patients
engagement.judgement: Opening entry at the model's first PARPi use. Engagement stays untested: the trial's only tumour assay was baseline WES/BROCA-HR genotyping, not an on-treatment hypoxia or RAD51 readout.

dose.quote: Here we show that PARP inhibition to block BER is toxic to hypoxic cancer cells, in which homology-dependent repair (HDR) is known to be down-regulated.
dose.note: Hypoxic-cell assays set no exposure target; NCI10066 escalated to full-dose olaparib 300 mg BID with ramucirumab 8 mg/kg.
dose.short: No exposure target from the model
dose.judgement: Untested rather than contra-derived-from-efficacy: the model gave no exposure or occupancy target to reach, and the RP2D was the full monotherapy dose, so nothing the model stated about dose was tested. Mirrors the draft's handling of the ATM cell-line track.

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. The trial paper (Cecchini 2023) names this Yale work (its refs 7-8: Bindra 2004, Hegan 2010) as 'our preclinical work'; Chan 2010 (doi 10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-10-2352) independently showed the same PARPi hypersensitivity of hypoxic cells. efficacy.quote: Here we show that PARP inhibition to block BER is toxic to hypoxic cancer cells, in which homology-dependent repair (HDR) is known to be down-regulated.
efficacy.note: Hypoxia down-regulates RAD51/BRCA1 and makes cells PARPi-sensitive; the prediction that induced hypoxia sensitises tumours was untested in patients.
efficacy.short: Hypoxic cells PARPi-sensitive, no patient test
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry. Class-level prediction: an anti-angiogenic should make HR-proficient tumours behave as HRD and respond to a PARP inhibitor.

efficacy.population: Metastatic gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma after >=1 line, unselected, stratified by 17-gene HRD status (NCI10066, n=51)
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC10844282). Registry NCT03008278 results first posted 2025-06-04 (ORR, PFS); the paper (epub 2023-12-22) is the earlier public comparison. The go-rule sentence: 'The therapy would be worthy of further investigation if there were >=1 response in tumours with HRD alterations and >=4 responses in tumours without evidence of HRD alterations'. No rucaparib or pamiparib patient data on this track.
efficacy.quote: For the six patients with PRs, two had HRD-positive tumours, one HRD-negative cancer, and three did not have genomic results.
efficacy.note: Phase 2 go-rule needed >=4 responses in HRD-negative tumours; one seen (ORR 6/43, 14%, CI 4.7-25.6 spans the 5% null).
efficacy.short: Hypoxia-sensitisation bar missed in HRD-negative gastric
efficacy.judgement: The paper states the comparison itself ('Our preclinical work revealed tumour hypoxia induces HRD... We aimed to induce tumour hypoxia with ramucirumab thereby sensitising tumours to olaparib'). The hypoxia mechanism is tested in HR-proficient tumours, where the pre-specified rule required >=4 responses and one occurred; the overall ORR CI includes the <=5% null. The authors call the regimen active versus historical ramucirumab (14% vs 3%), so source_calls_it is partial and the status is contra on the primary endpoint rule, not same. Single-arm phase 1/2 with three responders unsequenced, hence medium confidence. Dose and engagement unchanged.

patient_trials.quote: In evaluable patients at the RP2D the ORR was 6/43 (14%) (95% CI 4.7-25.6).

added_models.model: Gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma PDX platform and PDX-derived primary cells, BRCA2 germline-mutant with loss of the wild-type allele, olaparib/rucaparib/niraparib xenotrials

engagement.population: 165 sequenced GEA PDXs; 10 HR-gene-mutant PDXs and 7 germline-BRCA2 PDXs challenged with olaparib
engagement.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC10183806; epub 2023-05-01). Olaparib and rucaparib (and niraparib) were run in the PDX-derived primary cells; olaparib in the xenotrials. The paper's own patient cohort (57 GEA patients) was platinum-treated, so it is not a class-member comparison.
engagement.quote: Cell viability assays and preclinical trials showed that olaparib treatment was effective in PDXs harboring BRCA2 germline mutations and somatic inactivation of the second allele.
engagement.note: Model readouts were RAD51 foci and HRD/mutational-signature scores in PDXs; no PARPi PD was read in BRCA2-mutant gastric patients.
engagement.short: PDX HRD readouts not read in patients
engagement.judgement: Opening entry; nobody has compared the PDX HRD readouts with an on-treatment patient measurement.

dose.population: 165 sequenced GEA PDXs; 10 HR-gene-mutant PDXs and 7 germline-BRCA2 PDXs challenged with olaparib
dose.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC10183806; epub 2023-05-01). Olaparib and rucaparib (and niraparib) were run in the PDX-derived primary cells; olaparib in the xenotrials. The paper's own patient cohort (57 GEA patients) was platinum-treated, so it is not a class-member comparison.
dose.quote: Cell viability assays and preclinical trials showed that olaparib treatment was effective in PDXs harboring BRCA2 germline mutations and somatic inactivation of the second allele.
dose.note: Xenotrial dosing set no human exposure target; off-label olaparib in gastric patients used the approved 300 mg BID with no PK comparison.
dose.judgement: Opening entry; untested because the model stated no exposure target and no patient PK was compared.

efficacy.population: 165 sequenced GEA PDXs; 10 HR-gene-mutant PDXs and 7 germline-BRCA2 PDXs challenged with olaparib
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC10183806; epub 2023-05-01). Olaparib and rucaparib (and niraparib) were run in the PDX-derived primary cells; olaparib in the xenotrials. The paper's own patient cohort (57 GEA patients) was platinum-treated, so it is not a class-member comparison.
efficacy.quote: Cell viability assays and preclinical trials showed that olaparib treatment was effective in PDXs harboring BRCA2 germline mutations and somatic inactivation of the second allele.
efficacy.note: Of 10 HR-gene-mutant PDXs, only germline-BRCA2 with loss of the wild-type allele responded to olaparib; the paper's patient cohort was platinum-treated, not PARPi.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry at the platform's first PARPi use. Patient-level prediction: germline BRCA2 with second-allele loss picks the gastric cancers that respond. Prospective: no PARPi result in BRCA2-mutant gastric patients existed in 2023 (GOLD and PARALLEL 303 were unselected).

efficacy.magnitude_basis: OS hazard ratio for olaparib + paclitaxel vs paclitaxel in HR-gene-mutant gastric cancer against PDX tumour response
efficacy.population: Advanced/metastatic gastric cancer with pathogenic variants in 10 HR genes (ATM, BARD1, BRCA1, BRCA2, BRIP1, CDK12, CHEK2, PALB2, RAD51C, RAD51D), Kyoto, Japan
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC11592444; brief report, epub 2024-10-29). Described as a multicentre retrospective observational cancer-gene-panel study yet the olaparib arm is called randomised; arm counts (76 + 65) do not match the stated total of 132; no registry record found, so registry_date is null. Does not cite the PDX paper. Rucaparib and pamiparib have no patient data in this genotype.
efficacy.quote: Results showed that the olaparib plus paclitaxel group had a significantly longer overall survival (OS) than the paclitaxel alone group.
efficacy.note: HR-gene-PV gastric cancer (germline BRCA1/2 enriched to 50%): OS HR 0.57 with olaparib + paclitaxel, 0.36 in the HRD-positive subset.
efficacy.short: HR-mutant gastric patients benefit from olaparib
efficacy.judgement: Paired comparison I made: the PDX model (model_src) predicted PARPi benefit confined to BRCA2-driven gastric cancers; this Kyoto series reports longer OS with olaparib plus paclitaxel in HR-gene-mutant gastric cancer, direction only. The population (pathogenic variants in any of 10 HR genes) is broader than the model's BRCA2-plus-LOH genotype, and the report is internally inconsistent, so confidence is low; a later genotype-exact case strengthens it (next entry).

efficacy.magnitude_basis: RECIST-like PDX response vs patient complete metabolic response
efficacy.population: One patient, metastatic gastric adenocarcinoma, germline BRCA2 c.2945del with somatic LOH, third-line olaparib
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC13095560; epub 2026-04-07). Case report, no registry.
efficacy.quote: The patient achieved a complete metabolic response on FDG PET-CT, which has been sustained for more than three years under continuous olaparib therapy with acceptable tolerability.
efficacy.note: Germline BRCA2 frameshift with somatic LOH, the model's exact responder genotype: durable complete metabolic response on off-label olaparib after chemo-immunotherapy.
efficacy.short: BRCA2-LOH patient: durable CR on olaparib
efficacy.judgement: Strengthens, not a status change: one case report (n=1, selection-biased by publication) whose genotype matches the PDX model's responder definition exactly (germline BRCA2 loss-of-function plus loss of the wild-type allele). Paired by me; the case report does not cite the PDX paper.

considered_not_added: Rucaparib + ramucirumab +/- nivolumab (NCT03995017, n=34, status UNKNOWN, no results posted, no paper found): rucaparib has no patient comparison in gastric cancer; its only model use is in vitro in the BRCA2 PDX-derived primary cells (Petrelli 2023), which the gastric-pdx-brca2-germline track covers. Finding nothing is the finding.

Pamiparib's own preclinical models (BRCA-mutant breast/ovarian xenografts, cross-indication): PARALLEL 303's rationale was platinum sensitivity as an HRD surrogate, already tracked as parpi-cross-indication-hrd; no gastric model for pamiparib found.

MEDIOLA gastric cohort (olaparib + durvalumab; PARPi-induced STING/PD-L1 rationale from ovarian/breast models): patient result exists only as an ASCO GI 2019 abstract (no admissible tier); no full paper found.

Germline ATM-mutated gastric cancer olaparib case report (2024, doi 10.1177/23247096241240176): belongs to the existing ATM-low cell-line track, which is contra from Study 39/GOLD; a single case cannot turn a contra track (needs patient_signal_reversed with a tier 1-4 source).
Niraparib phase II in HRD gastric cancer (2024, doi 10.3389/fonc.2024.1435056): niraparib is not a member of this tile's class, so it does not score.
Gastric patient-derived organoids or ex-vivo drug sensitivity with a member drug: no study with a patient comparison found (agrees with the checker).
In-silico / PBPK / QSP dose models specific to gastric cancer: none found; Study 39's 100 mg BID olaparib with paclitaxel came from a phase 1 run-in (Bang 2015 Part A), not a model.

Jiang 2016 olaparib in hypoxic NSCLC xenografts (doi 10.1016/j.ijrobp.2016.01.035): same hypoxia-HRD system with a member drug dosed; folded into the hypoxia track's opening judgement rather than opened as a separate track.
Petrelli 2023's own 57-patient GEA cohort: platinum-treated, not a class-member comparison, so it sets no status on the PDX track.
AstraZeneca 2016 and BeiGene 2021 press releases (checker leads): dating corrections on existing tracks, not model systems.
